WOUNCY — ASSET CREDITS
Sources checked 14 November 2026.

BACKGROUND MUSIC
vitalezzz, “Singularity”
https://opengameart.org/content/singularity-0
License: CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- singularity-calm.mp3: calm version (menu and run summary)
- singularity-focus.mp3: synchronized mix of 60% calm and 40% action (gameplay)
Original files:
https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/singularity_calm.wav
https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/singularity_action.wav
Both full-length loops are retained. Converted to 96 kbps stereo MP3.
Menu normalized to -20 LUFS; gameplay mix normalized to -18 LUFS;
normalization targets a -2 dBTP ceiling and 9 LU loudness range.
Playback matches the calm track to the gameplay mix with a fixed +2.17 dB
trim. Music uses a steady bus level without bounce distortion or pause boosts;
menu/play transitions crossfade at the same position in the full-length loops.
License record: audio/Singularity-CC0.txt

SOUND EFFECTS
Kenney, “UI Audio” https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-audio
License: CC0 1.0. Original license: audio/Kenney-UI-CC0.txt
- lock.wav: Audio/click1.ogg
- recall.wav: Audio/switch3.ogg
Converted to mono 22050 Hz PCM WAV.

Kenney, “Music Jingles” https://kenney.nl/assets/music-jingles
License: CC0 1.0. Original license: audio/Kenney-Jingles-CC0.txt
All selected files come from Audio/Pizzicato jingles/:
- start.wav: jingles_PIZZI00.ogg (0.42 seconds)
- clear.wav: jingles_PIZZI02.ogg (capped at 0.45 seconds)
- retry.wav: jingles_PIZZI04.ogg (0.40 seconds)
- finish.wav: jingles_PIZZI09.ogg (capped at 1 second)
Trimmed with a short fade-out and converted to mono 22050 Hz PCM WAV.

The existing bounce-back.wav spoken chant was supplied with the game;
it is retained from the project's macOS Eddy voice recording.

DAVEN AND SCENERY
Original Hack Club Haven artwork: https://haven.hackclub.com/
- daven.webp: existing owner-supplied character
- daven-excited.webp: https://haven.hackclub.com/images/pitch/excited-daven.webp
- haven-hedgehog.webp: https://haven.hackclub.com/images/hedgehog.webp
- faq-sky.webp, faq-bushes-1.webp, faq-bushes-2.webp and
  footer-bottom-bushes.webp: existing Haven landscape assets
The original character images are displayed unchanged with CSS motion and props.
No AI-generated images or music were added. Haven artwork is credited here;
its reuse rights are separate from the CC0 audio licenses. No blanket license
for the artwork was found on the Haven page; confirm permission for redistribution.
This independently made game is not an official Hack Club product.
